answer: Failure mode one: an identity sits idle and keeps its score. Decay it 7 percent per epoch after two skipped epochs. Failure mode two: the same text lands twice. Forfeit the stake on the second copy, caught by hashing against the epoch log. A farm sending 2,000 identities on one voyage pays 2,000 stakes for one payout, and a whisper of profit dies at the duplicate check. The wharf charges every account that docks, idle or not.
